title: Existing premium-brand price evidence admitted under the M1 ladder
notes: Extraction is limited to the 78 existing integrated passenger versions of BMW, MINI, Audi, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, Volvo and Polestar. Original JSON and source records remain unchanged; no external research was performed.
All candidate amounts were observed on 10 October 2026 in the held evidence. The extraction/expiry assessment date is 13 October 2026, not a new source check.

The 9 integrated qualified_derived_price_aud MINI facts were inspected first but not promoted: they subtract dealer delivery and round. Their source IDs and variant mappings are reused with the directly published gross from-price instead.
BMW iX1 Sport Collection A$79,900 campaign is current through 31 March 2027, but there is no matching integrated Sport Collection version. It is not applied to xDrive30 M Sport.

The Volvo EX30 A$55,990 campaign uses older Single Motor Extended Range naming and does not fix MY; it is not rebound to MY27 P5. Future/older/audit-only configurations are not added to the catalogue by this extraction.

Empty comparisonBasis means the amount is useful to display but its tax/on-road basis is insufficiently comparable. Dealer prices are source-reported and unranked. No physical stock claim is inferred.
